event.description: Reduced only the two feed-forward hidden layers from ff=48 to ff=44 at d=16, h=2, L=2.
event.proposal: Parameterization-preserving compression hypothesis: carry and position identities require the incumbent 16-channel residual stream, but four MLP features per block are redundant; reducing ff from 48 to 44 should save 128 unique parameters without changing attention.
